touch.d: Slowly trace your fingers over their forearm, from wrist to elbow and back.
Trace every line on their palm with one fingertip. Say what each line means to you.
Massage their shoulders for two minutes. Ask where it feels best.
Run your fingers through their hair for one minute. Let them close their eyes.
Give one foot a slow, firm rub for two minutes, then switch.
Write a short word on their back with your finger. They guess it.
Hold their face in both hands and say one thing you love about it.
Hold them from behind and sway together for 30 seconds.
Kiss each fingertip of one hand, slowly.
Press foreheads together. Match your breathing. No talking for 30 seconds.
Softly nibble where their neck meets their shoulder.
Kiss from their wrist to the inside of the elbow, slowly.
Give a slow scalp massage with your fingertips for three minutes.
Trace feather-light lines on the outside of their thigh for one minute.
Kiss and breathe softly along their ear and jaw.
Press your thumbs into their lower back in slow circles for two minutes.
Lie together skin to skin for two minutes, no agenda.
Warm some oil in your hands and massage their back or legs for four minutes.
Kiss them from neck to ankle, slowly, ending on their lips.
Drag your nails lightly down their back and arms. Watch their reaction.

gaze.d: Look into their eyes for 30 seconds without speaking or laughing.
Blink slowly while holding their gaze for 20 seconds. A signal of trust.
Sit face to face and match your breathing for one minute.
Smile with just your eyes for 15 seconds. See who cracks first.
Rub noses softly, then rest foreheads together for 20 seconds.
Copy each other's slow movements as if in a mirror for one minute.
Hold each other close for one full minute without a word.
Look at them and guess three things they are thinking. They confirm or correct.
Lean in until your lips are a breath apart. Stay for 15 seconds, then pull back.
Do not look away while they slowly say three things they want tonight.
Look only at their lips for 10 seconds, then eyes, then lips again.
Stand a hand's width apart. Do not touch for 30 seconds. Then kiss.
Kiss slowly without closing your eyes.
Look at them slowly from head to toe, then tell them what you noticed.

vocal.d: Whisper something you truly admire about their soul.
Say three specific things about their body you find beautiful. No generic lines.
Tell them three small things they did this week that you loved.
Tell them what you remember most about the first time you saw them.
Invent a private pet name for them and use it all night.
Say one thing you would love to do together this month.
Whisper a love note in their ear as if recording a voice message.
Complete aloud: 'What I love most about touching you is...'
Whisper a fantasy about somewhere new you want to try together, in detail.
Tell them exactly how you would like to be kissed. Then be kissed that way.
Whisper three things you would love to happen tonight.
Give five compliments in a row about how they make you feel in bed.
Make up a short, steamy poem about them and whisper it.
Whisper a promise for later and seal it with a kiss.
Confess a fantasy you have never said out loud. They can only listen.
Describe in detail what you want them to do next.
Ask for what you want, using the word please every time.
Describe your favourite moment together in the most sensual detail you can.

sensory.d: Run warm hands over their body, then cool fingertips on the same spots. Four times.
Press chests together and synchronise ten slow breaths.
Blindfold them and feed them three small tastes. They guess each one.
Trace a cube of ice along their collarbone and kiss the water away.
Trace a feather, silk scarf or soft brush over their skin for two minutes.
Press your face into their neck or hair and breathe deeply. Tell them what it makes you feel.
Choose a slow song and dance close, eyes closed, for the whole song.
Light a candle, dim the lights and give each other a slow shoulder rub.
Kiss them after sharing something sweet. Notice the taste.
Share a mint, then kiss. Notice the cool and the warm.
Slide something silky slowly over their back, arms and legs.
Blindfold them. Touch with five textures: fabric, ice, feather, lips, fingertips.
Sip something warm, then something cold, and kiss them each time.
Turn off the lights. Only whispering and touch for three minutes.
Warm some oil and massage their hands and arms until they relax.
Breathe slowly along their neck and shoulders without touching.
Loosely tie their wrists with a soft scarf (easy to slip out). Tease slowly for three minutes.
Put on headphones with one song each. Dance together and then kiss.

wild.d: Remove one item of their clothing, taking at least 60 full seconds.
Pull them closer by the waist with firm confidence and kiss them.
Tell them exactly how you want to be touched right now. They follow your instructions.
They close their eyes. Touch them in three places with a surprise object or your lips.
One lies still with eyes closed. The other explores from neck to ankle using only their lips.
For three minutes the passive partner takes complete control. The active partner follows.
Both write one thing you have never asked for. Swap papers and talk it through for five minutes.
Perform a slow dance for them. They decide how it ends.
Tease them for two minutes, stop, and make them wait 30 seconds. Repeat.
For five minutes, give them clear commands. They obey. Safe word always applies.
Perform a slow striptease down to the item of your choice.
Gently hold their wrists above their head and kiss their neck for one minute.
Lead them by the hand to the bedroom and take charge of the pace.
Whisper three things you want them to do. They do each one slowly.
Show them how you like to be touched, then watch them copy it.
Change into something they love while they watch, then ask for their reaction.
Let them choose where you kiss them. Spend three minutes there, then move to another.
Choose what they wear tonight. They choose what you wear.
Make a list of three things you want to happen. Do them in order, slowly.
